journey.name: onchain original payment retry
journey.description: Verifies explicit fee approval and normal spend authentication for retrying one original software on-chain payment. Precondition: an onboarded funded dev wallet, payment PIN enabled, biometrics disabled, a synced node, and a retained unresolved prepared-send receipt with its exact original recipient, amount, inputs and candidate transaction IDs. Creating a controlled refusal or response-loss fixture is not provided by the Capabilities table and remains in Manual Tests. A seeded Pending fixture must be labelled as state injection, never as proof of a native fault. Keep the original outcome unresolved during the cancellation steps. Manual Tests must verify the exact backend winning transaction retains the complete original input set and recipient amount, and any original Shop request or Blocktank order completes once without a new request or order. Local activity alone cannot prove these checks. See prepared-fee-recovery.md in this directory for the four shared manual fee-recovery cases and platform adaptations. Record native fault coverage separately.

actions.action: Open the retained original payment's Pending screen and record its displayed transaction ID
Verify Pending describes the unresolved outcome and offers Retry original payment
Verify the dialog shows the original recipient and amount and prefills the original fee rate
Leave the fee dialog open for 30 seconds, then tap Cancel; verify the original Pending payment remains retained and tap Retry original payment again
Enter an invalid fee rate of 1000 sat/vB and verify valid positive fee feedback appears and Continue is disabled
Enter a valid authorized fee rate that the funded fixture can support and tap Continue

Verify the exact prepared mining fee in sats is shown beside the original recipient amount; leave this approval open for 30 seconds, then tap Cancel and verify the original Pending payment remains retained

Tap Retry original payment again, choose the fixture-supported fee, tap Continue, approve the exact prepared fee and any normal fee warnings, and verify the normal payment PIN screen appears before dispatch
Leave the payment PIN screen open for 30 seconds and verify it still awaits authentication
Use Android system Back or iOS header Back without entering the PIN; verify the original Pending payment remains retained and Retry original payment is enabled again
Tap Retry original payment again, choose the fixture-supported fee, tap Continue, approve the exact prepared fee and any normal fee warnings
Enter the fixture's normal payment PIN without recording entered digits
Wait for Bitcoin Sent only after exact positive evidence, or verify Pending remains with a readable error if fee headroom is insufficient
If successful, tap Details then Explore and record the exact winning transaction ID shown by TXID
